data.spiritual_significance: In a Christian context, the name Folsom can symbolize the belief that even in the deepest valleys or the most trying of circumstances, God is still with us and can provide strength and guidance. The name can be a reminder to trust in the Lord's divine plan and to keep the faith, even when faced with adversity.
